Maya (CSM): Heads-up - customer Albright rolled their web widgets to staging and hit 429s during a load test. Theysee failures within first 5s. Renewal check-in next week so theywant this fast.

Dev (Support): Can you paste a tiny log window? 429s during init usually point at preflight/token fanout.

Maya (CSM): Log snippet they sent:
```
2026-04-02T11:45:01Z WARN preflight deny tenant=albright count=96 window=1s
2026-04-02T11:45:01Z ERROR http 429 preflight_token_unavailable
```

Rhea (DevEx): 96/s looks like many components calling SDK.init() concurrently. Quick fix: disable auto token prefetch in components and fetch once per session. Also add a short randomized splay (200-1200ms) before init.

Dev (Support): For immediate relief ops can bump the tenant preflight burst. Ops bot - can you open a CR for a short-lived quota increase?

ops-bot: CR-8102 opened to bump preflight burst for tenant=albright from 100/s -> 400/s for 2 hours. Notifying #eng-oncall.

Maya (CSM): I'll tell the customer to roll the client change to staging and validate. Also told them to implement exponential backoff on 429s so UX is graceful.

Rhea (DevEx): I'll add a one-paragraph onboarding note about "single token per session + splay on init" and add a tiny code snippet to the docs.

Dev (Support): Please update this thread when they validate so we can close CR-8102. If errors persist, we'll extend the window or investigate tenant pool sizing.

Maya (CSM): Will do. Thanks everyone.
